name: The Good Fellas
caption: Lost their first-round WIW Tag Team Title tournament bout to the Hitmen on the promotion's first-ever broadcast.

tenures.source: the promotion's own Wednesday Night Warfare broadcast of 11 June 1997

name: The Hitmen
caption: Advanced past the Good Fellas in the first round of the inaugural WIW Tag Team Title tournament, managed by Agent X.

tenures.source: the promotion's own Wednesday Night Warfare broadcast of 11 June 1997

name: The Brew Crew
caption: Advanced past the Confederate Connection in the first round of the inaugural WIW Tag Team Title tournament.

name: The Towers of Power
caption: Advanced past the Men in Black on a disputed pinfall, then reached the WIW Tag Team Title final by default when their semifinal opponents were double disqualified.

tenures.source: the promotion's own Wednesday Night Warfare broadcast of 11 June 1997

name: The Men in Black
caption: Lost their first-round WIW Tag Team Title tournament bout to the Towers of Power on a pinfall the broadcast's own commentary called illegitimate.

name: The Extreme Team
caption: Their first-round WIW Tag Team Title tournament bout against the Asylum ended in a double disqualification.

name: The Asylum
caption: Their first-round WIW Tag Team Title tournament bout against the Extreme Team ended in a double disqualification, advancing the Towers of Power instead.
